scenes.title: Delete all [[blank rows]] in 5 seconds
scenes.tamil: Tally export-ல blank rows நிறைய இருக்கா?
scenes.say: Delete all blank rows from a Tally export in five seconds.
scenes.say_ta: Tally export-ல blank rows நிறைய இருக்கா?

scenes.code:
F5 > Special > Blanks > OK
Ctrl + minus > Entire row
scenes.say: Press F5, choose Special, then Blanks. Then delete the entire rows.
